name: Tellhow Sci-Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Tellhow Sci-Tech Co., Ltd. provides military equipment and intelligent power in China and internationally. The company offers communication command system integration and information vehicles; satellite navigation and vehicle electronic information system products; photoelectric imaging and precision tracking and measuring products; combat command support systems; military power station and mechatronics products; military air conditioner products; ammunition and weapon systems; fuses; and rocket/missile engine charges.
